strengths: The opening line is vivid, plain, and not decorative.
Repentance is distinguished from excuses and repair is made concrete.
Grace alone, union with Christ, and sanctification are all active in the prayer.
concerns: No blocker; the repeated baseline phrase about repentance turning and walking is expected scaffolding rather than source copying.
grader_note: Approved. One of the strongest prayers in the set for architecture, speakability, and audience fit.
